name: Waiter
source: WHO IS THIS GUY?! All you know is he's your waiter on this date, and he's way over-the-top! Cartwheeling, wiggling, spewing inconceivable lines of dialogue... And somehow... you're getting to know him as the march of doom on your date. Watch out!
